title: Hearty Roasted Australian Lamb Roast
description: A savory and comforting Australian dish featuring roasted lamb and melted butter, perfect for a sick day or special occasion. This keto-friendly recipe is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb roast with garlic powder, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb roast until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast the lamb for 20 minutes per pound, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Baste the lamb with melted butter every 20 minutes during the roasting time.
Remove the lamb from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
